tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Warm off-white in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list containers, inputs. The dark value is the app icon's steel tile.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and popovers that sit above a surface. In light, separation comes from shadow-md instead.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: search fields at rest, code blocks, empty states.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around cards. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control. Dark value = the icon's edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls: unchecked checkboxes, input outlines. Meets 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg and surface. 16:1 and up in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: quantities, timestamps, helper text. 7:1+ on surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Checked-off list items (with line-through) and placeholders. 4.6:1+ on surface, so still readable.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The constant brand orange: primary buttons, checked checkboxes, links, the selected tab. Deeper in light (#c83c00) so text and links pass 4.5:1 on white and cream; the light app icon keeps its brighter #e04400 because a graphic needs only 3:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled or written in brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and ticks on a brand fill. White in light (5.1:1), steel black in dark (4.9:1), mirroring the icon's tick.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected rows, the active nav item, info banners. Light value is the Light steel icon tile (shell).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Fixed brand black, the same in both themes. Only for brand moments such as the app icon tile or a marketing band; UI text uses ink.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Fixed brand cream, the same in both themes. Only for brand moments; UI tints use brand-subtle.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset from the control.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations such as 'List shared'. Not used for checked items, which use brand.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: delete item, failed sync, invalid input.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and the swipe-to-delete reveal.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero and empty-state headline. Once per screen at most.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title, such as the open list's name.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings: aisles or categories inside a list.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: List item names and running text. 16px keeps mobile browsers from zooming into inputs.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels such as 'In cart'. Always ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in docs and settings.

styles.name: quantity
styles.usage: Quantities and units aligned at the end of list rows; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside small chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a checkbox and its label; between stacked small elements.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phones, horizontal row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop; space above section headings.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large section breaks and empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing page section padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, chips, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows when they stand alone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App-icon squircle ratio (11 on 48). Use for avatar tiles and list thumbnails so they echo the icon.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: count badges, segmented controls, the floating add button.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards. In dark, a 1px steel edge replaces the shadow, which would be invisible.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the floating add button.
